claims.statement: The Fourth Dynasty includes the reigns of Snefru, Khufu, Djedefre, Khafre and Menkaure. The Met places it at approximately 2575–2465 BCE, within the Old Kingdom.

evidence.locator: Dynasty 4 heading and ordered ruler list
evidence.note: Approximate chronology and succession follow the Met’s Dynasty 4 list.
